about.heroTitle: “I went from flipping houses to helping neighbors one family at a time.”
about.heroLead: El Paso born, bilingual, and building community one transaction at a time.
about.imageAlt: Portrait of Angelina Gándara, El Paso real estate agent
about.bioTitle: From one flip to a city of homeowners.
about.paragraph1: I grew up watching my grandmother devotedly care for the homes she worked hard to save for; those same homes later became her only source of retirement income.
about.paragraph2: About 6 years ago, I decided to take a leap of faith (with some careful planning) and follow her example by investing in fixing and flipping a house.
about.paragraph3: Today, I own and manage several properties in our city. The success I found inspired me to become a realtor, allowing me to help my neighbors become homeowners, too… and maybe inspire a few to venture into investment properties.
about.quote: “My grandmother taught me that a home is more than a roof it's security, it's legacy, it's the foundation everything else is built on.”
about.credentialsBody: Licensed Real Estate Agent · TREC #844593-SA · With Home Pros Real Estate Group LLC.

buyers.heroTitle: Buying in El Paso, without the guesswork.
buyers.heroLead: First-time or moving back the process, the neighborhoods, and the paperwork, made simple, in your language.
buyers.processLead: From “just looking” to keys in hand here's exactly what working together looks like.
buyers.step1Title: Let's talk share what you're looking for.
buyers.step1Body: A 20-minute call to understand your budget, timeline, neighborhoods, and must-haves. English or Spanish your call.
buyers.step2Body: You get instant listing alerts the moment a matching home hits the MLS. I pre-screen each one so you only tour the ones worth your time.
buyers.step3Body: We tour on your schedule evenings and weekends included. I point out what an untrained eye might miss: condition, value, and red flags.
buyers.step4Body: I price your offer sharp, negotiate hard, and coordinate inspections and lenders right through closing day. You sign with full clarity.
buyers.marketTitle: Know the numbers before you buy.
buyers.statsDisclaimer: Figures are approximate, based on recent local MLS data. Your experience will vary by neighborhood, price band, and season.
buyers.faqLead: Don't see yours? Just ask usually answered within minutes.
buyers.faq1Q: Do you work with first-time buyers?
buyers.faq1A: Absolutely first-time buyers are some of my favorite clients. I walk you through every step, from pre-approval to closing, with no jargon and no pressure. You'll know exactly what to expect at every milestone, and you'll never feel rushed into a decision.
buyers.faq2A: Yes. Every part of the process showings, contracts, negotiations, and closing is available fully in Spanish. You review and sign documents in the language you're most comfortable in, and I translate lender and title paperwork so nothing gets lost in the gap.
buyers.faq3A: Most texts and calls are answered within minutes during the day, and always within a few hours. If I'm in a closing, you'll get an automated heads-up with a callback window you'll never wonder where your agent went.
buyers.faq4Q: How do you help me compete in a fast market?
buyers.faq4A: I set you up with instant listing alerts, make sure your pre-approval is airtight, and tour homes the day they hit the market. When it's time to write an offer, I'll price it sharp and structure terms that win without overpaying including escalation clauses, flexible closing, and seller-friendly timelines where it makes sense.
buyers.faq5Q: What's the process start to finish?
buyers.faq5A: We start with a getting-to-know-you call, then pre-approval, then showings and tours, then offer and negotiation, inspection and due diligence, and finally closing day. I keep you informed at every step in English or Spanish, and I'm with you at the closing table not handing you off to an assistant.
buyers.ctaBody: Book a free 20-minute buyer consultation English or Spanish, no obligation.

sellers.heroLead: Local pricing intelligence, honest advice, and a team that answers so your home sells on your schedule.

sellers.whyTitle: A listing strategy that actually works in El Paso.
sellers.whyLead: No inflated promises just honest pricing, responsive communication, and marketing that reaches real buyers.
sellers.value1Title: Know what your home is worth
sellers.value1Body: A real comparative market analysis built from recent El Paso sales not a Zestimate guess. You'll see the comps, the adjustments, and the strategy behind your number.
sellers.value2Body: Need to close in 30 days? Need time to find your next home? I'll build the listing, showings, and closing dates around your life not the other way around.
sellers.value3Title: Marketing that gets your home in front of real buyers
sellers.value3Body: Professional photography, bilingual listing copy, MLS syndication to Zillow and Realtor.com, plus targeted social reach. More eyes, better offers, faster.
sellers.faq1Q: How do you price a home?
sellers.faq1A: I pull recent comparable sales within the last 90 days within a tight radius, adjust for condition, features, and lot, and factor in current competition. You get a clear recommended range with the data behind it no inflated flattery, just honest strategy designed to sell at the best price in the right timeframe.
sellers.faq2Q: How do you market my home?
sellers.faq2A: Professional photography, a bilingual listing description, full MLS syndication to Zillow, Realtor.com, and downstream portals, plus targeted social and email reach to my buyer network. I also leverage local investor and buyer contacts for pre-listing buzz before the home even goes live.
sellers.faq3A: Commission is fully negotiable and depends on the scope of the sale. We'll discuss the exact number up front during your listing consultation no surprises and no hidden fees. Texas law does not set commission rates; they are always determined between you and your broker.
sellers.faqMore: Have a different question? Ask Angelina directly.

westside.name: Westside
westside.metaTitle: Westside El Paso Neighborhood Guide | Angelina Gándara
westside.metaDescription: Westside El Paso foothills, golf courses, top-rated schools. Quick facts, median prices, and what locals love about living in Westside.
westside.heroLead: Foothills, golf courses, and top-rated schools El Paso's premier residential area along the western slopes of the Franklin Mountains.
westside.localsLove: Foothill trails, Keller Park, and sunset views over the Franklins.
westside.overview1: The Westside is where El Paso's foothills meet its most established residential streets. Homes here range from mid-century ranches in Mountain View to custom builds in Coronado Heights, all within minutes of hiking trails, golf courses, and some of the city's best dining on Mesa Street.
westside.overview2: It's the neighborhood people move to when they want space, good schools, and mountain views without leaving city limits.

highlights.title: Franklin Mountain trails
highlights.body: Hundreds of miles of hiking and biking trails start practically at your doorstep. The Tom Mays Unit and Franklin Mountains State Park are minutes away.

highlights.title: Top-rated schools
highlights.body: Served by EPISD's Coronado High School feeder pattern one of El Paso's most sought-after school zones.

highlights.title: Mesa Street scene
highlights.body: Restaurants, coffee shops, and retail along Mesa Street El Paso's westside commercial spine, walkable from many neighborhoods.

westside.ctaBody: Book a free 20-minute call. I'll walk you through current inventory, pricing, and what to expect in English or Spanish.

upperValley.name: Upper Valley
upperValley.metaTitle: Upper Valley El Paso Neighborhood Guide | Angelina Gándara
upperValley.metaDescription: Upper Valley El Paso mature trees, river views, big lots. Quick facts, median prices, and what locals love about living in Upper Valley.
upperValley.heroLead: Mature trees, river views, and big lots with character along the Rio Grande one of El Paso's most established and charming corridors.
upperValley.localsLove: Mature trees, the Rio Grande levee path, and big lots with character.
upperValley.overview1: The Upper Valley follows the Rio Grande through some of El Paso's oldest residential streets. Canopy roads, irrigated lots, and a mix of mid-century ranches and custom homes give this area a distinctly green, established feel rare in a desert city.
upperValley.overview2: It's the neighborhood for buyers who want trees, space between houses, and a ten-minute drive to downtown.
upperValley.bookAreaCta: Book a Call About Upper Valley

highlights.title: Rio Grande levee path
highlights.body: A paved walking and biking trail runs along the levee residents use it daily for exercise, dog walks, and riverside sunsets.

highlights.title: Character homes & big lots
highlights.body: Irrigated lots, mature shade trees, and architectural variety from mid-century ranches to custom builds with river proximity.

highlights.title: Minutes to downtown
highlights.body: One of El Paso's closest residential areas to downtown, the hospitals, and UTEP without the density of central neighborhoods.

upperValley.ctaBody: Book a free 20-minute call. I'll walk you through current inventory, pricing, and what to expect in English or Spanish.

eastSide.name: East Side / Horizon City
eastSide.metaTitle: East Side / Horizon City El Paso Neighborhood Guide | Angelina Gándara
eastSide.metaDescription: East Side / Horizon City El Paso new builds, growing families, value pricing. Quick facts, median prices, and what locals love.
eastSide.heroLead: New builds, growing families, and value pricing on El Paso's expanding east corridor where your dollar goes further and the neighborhoods are still growing.
eastSide.factLabel: East Side / Horizon City quick facts
eastSide.localsLove: New builds, growing family neighborhoods, and quick access to Joe Battle Blvd.
eastSide.overviewTitle: Living in East Side / Horizon City
eastSide.overview1: The East Side is El Paso's fastest-growing residential corridor, stretching from the established neighborhoods near Zaragoza out toward Horizon City. New construction dominates here single-family homes built in the last decade, with modern floor plans, energy-efficient features, and prices that make first-time and move-up buyers take notice.
eastSide.overview2: It's the neighborhood for buyers who want more house for their budget, good schools, and room to grow.
eastSide.bookAreaCta: Book a Call About East Side

highlights.title: New construction
highlights.body: El Paso's largest inventory of new builds modern floor plans, energy-efficient construction, and builder incentives that can lower your closing costs.

highlights.title: Family-friendly community
highlights.body: Parks, splash pads, youth sports leagues, and newer schools the East Side is built for families at every stage.

highlights.title: Value pricing
highlights.body: More square footage, larger lots, and newer construction per dollar than anywhere else in El Paso the best value for first-time and move-up buyers.

eastSide.ctaBody: Book a free 20-minute call. I'll walk you through new-build inventory, builder reputations, and what to expect in English or Spanish.

fortBliss.name: Fort Bliss Area
fortBliss.metaTitle: Fort Bliss Area El Paso Neighborhood Guide | Angelina Gándara
fortBliss.metaDescription: Fort Bliss area El Paso VA-savvy, relocation-ready, minutes from post. Quick facts, median prices, and what locals love about living near Fort Bliss.
fortBliss.heroLead: VA-savvy, relocation-ready, and minutes from post El Paso's military-friendly zone where the commute is short and the neighborhoods are quiet.
fortBliss.localsLove: VA-savvy lenders, short commute to post, and quiet residential streets.
fortBliss.overview1: The neighborhoods surrounding Fort Bliss including Northeast El Paso, the Lower Valley, and the Castner Heights area are built for military life. Short commutes to post, affordable single-family homes, and access to both EPISD and Ysleta ISD schools make this a practical choice for active-duty families and veterans alike.
fortBliss.overview2: Angelina understands VA loans, BAH calculations, and the timeline pressures of PCS moves she's helped dozens of military families buy and sell on tight schedules.
fortBliss.bookAreaCta: Book a Call About Fort Bliss
fortBliss.livingTitle: What makes Fort Bliss area special.

highlights.title: VA loan expertise
highlights.body: Angelina works with VA-approved lenders who know El Paso. Zero-down, no PMI, and closing cost contributions she'll make sure you use every benefit you've earned.

highlights.title: Minutes from post
highlights.body: Neighborhoods within 10-15 minutes of the gate Castner Heights, Logan Heights, and Northeast El Paso give you the shortest possible commute to formation.

highlights.title: Quiet residential streets
highlights.body: Established neighborhoods with mature trees, low traffic, and family-friendly cul-de-sacs not the cookie-cutter density you might expect near a military installation.

fortBliss.ctaBody: Book a free 20-minute relocation call. I'll walk you through neighborhoods, schools, and VA loan logistics in English or Spanish.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: Angelina Gándara (operating with Home Pros Real Estate Group LLC) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect through this website, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using this site, you agree to this policy.
privacy.ctaBody: Call or text Angelina directly we're happy to explain exactly how your information is used.

blocks.text: We collect information you choose to share with us, which may include:

items: Contact details: name, email address, phone number
Property details: address of a property you ask us to evaluate, property type, and related details
Buyer details: your price range, preferred area, and other search preferences
Booking details: if you schedule a call, the time and contact info you provide
Communications: the content of messages or chats you send us

blocks.text: We collect limited technical information automatically (such as browser type and pages visited) to keep the site working and secure.
We use your information to:

items: Respond to your inquiries (by phone, text, or email)
Provide the services you request, including valuations, consultations, and listing or buying support
Schedule and manage appointments
Maintain and improve our website and services
Send you information you've requested (and, where you've agreed, updates we think may be useful)

blocks.text: We collect and process your information to provide the services you request and to pursue our legitimate business interests, consistent with applicable Texas and U.S. law.
We do not sell your personal information. We may share it with:

items: Our brokerage, Home Pros Real Estate Group LLC, and its service providers, as needed to serve you
Service providers that help us operate (e.g., our contact, scheduling, chat, and messaging platforms)
Third parties when required by law, legal process, or to protect rights and safety

blocks.text: Our contact forms, chat, and appointment booking are powered by our customer-relationship platform (GoHighLevel). Information submitted through these tools is transmitted to and stored by that platform and becomes part of our customer records. Their own privacy practices apply to how they store and protect data.

items: You can ask us for a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
You can ask us to correct or delete your personal information, where applicable.
You can opt out of marketing emails or texts at any time by replying "STOP" or contacting us directly.
You can disable cookies in your browser settings; parts of the site (including some forms) may still work, and any third-party features are covered by their own policies.
We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

blocks.text: We keep your information only as long as needed to serve you and meet legal obligations. We use reasonable safeguards to protect your data, though no method of transmission is 100% secure.
Our site may link to third-party websites (such as Instagram, neighborhood guides, or listing portals). We are not responsible for their privacy practices.
We will honor requests to access, correct, or delete your personal information, consistent with applicable state and federal law.
For any request or question, contact:
